Order 
This is the third b ail application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 on behalf of applicant for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.414/2024, registered at Police Station-Narmada Nagar, District-Khanwa (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363,
366-A, 376, 376(2)(N), 376(3), 342, 506, 34 of IPC & Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act & Section 3(2)(v),
3(1)(w) of SC & ST (POA) Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
He is in jail since 29.11.2023.
It is submitted that applicant and prosecutrix were in love relationship.
Applicant had married the prosecutrix.
In these circumstances, prayer is made that applicant may be released on bail.
3 . Learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the bail application.
It is submitted that allegation of rape is made against applicant.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
2 MCRC-28891-2024 5.
Prosecutrix has stated in her statement that applicant and prosecutrix was married to each other.
Thereafter, applicant had committed rape on her.
Case of the applicant is distinguishable from other co-accused person-Vinod.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge-sheet has been filed.

6 . Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the period of custody of applicant,
bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail Bunty Kelkar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175644652/
1 on furnishing a bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard.
